verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no Vast.ai feature for defining automations that run on their own, such as scheduled or recurring jobs or event triggers. The CLI, REST API, SDK and scoped CI/CD keys are developer building blocks for scripting automation externally. The agent skill lets an outside coding assistant drive the account. Autobilling and serverless autoscaling are adjacent features, not user-configurable background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
